claim_support.claim: Formalized open-set recognition by defining open space risk for classifiers tested on previously unseen classes.
claim_support.evidence: IEEE TPAMI 2013 paper formulating open space risk and the 1-vs-Set Machine.

claim_support.claim: Showed deep networks output high confidence on unknown inputs and proposed OpenMax calibration.
claim_support.evidence: CVPR 2016 paper introducing OpenMax with Extreme Value Theory to bound open space risk.

claim_support.claim: Established Maximum Softmax Probability (MSP) as a standard out-of-distribution baseline for neural networks.
claim_support.evidence: Hendrycks and Gimpel baseline using max softmax probability for OOD detection.

claim_support.claim: Categorized open-set recognition methods into discriminative and generative distance/boundary formulations.
claim_support.evidence: IEEE TPAMI 2021 survey of OSR models, open space risk, and protocols.

claim_support.claim: Linked closed-set accuracy to open-set separability and highlighted semantic shift difficulty.
claim_support.evidence: Vaze et al. analysis of closed-set strength and semantic shift OSR evaluation.

claim_support.claim: Applied convolutional neural networks to object recognition in forward-looking sonar imagery.
claim_support.evidence: OCEANS 2016 paper evaluating CNNs on forward-looking sonar target crops.

claim_support.claim: Established convolutional architecture and preprocessing practices for forward-looking sonar classification.
claim_support.evidence: OCEANS 2017 Aberdeen study on CNN design for FLS images.

claim_support.claim: Demonstrated deep convolutional classifiers on underwater sonar imagery under speckle and orientation changes.
claim_support.evidence: ICPR 2016 paper applying deep CNNs to underwater sonar target classification.

claim_support.claim: Documented the water-tank Marine Debris FLS collection captured with a 3.0 MHz Sound Metrics ARIS Explorer 3000 sonar.
claim_support.evidence: ICCVW 2021 paper introducing the ARIS Explorer 3000 marine debris water-tank imagery.

claim_support.claim: Released the Marine Debris Forward-Looking Sonar (MD-FLS) water-tank classification splits used in this benchmark.
claim_support.evidence: MD-FLS datasets release covering watertank-cropped and companion splits.

claim_support.claim: Investigated open-set recognition on forward-looking sonar imagery with long-tail class distributions.
claim_support.evidence: Expert Systems with Applications 2024 article addressing sonar OSR.

claim_support.claim: Proposed Class-balanced OpenMax to calibrate logits under imbalanced sonar open-set recognition.
claim_support.evidence: Expert Systems with Applications 2026 paper calibrating OpenMax tails for sonar.

claim_support.claim: Formulated One-Class SVM for estimating the high-dimensional support of known training representations.
claim_support.evidence: Neural Computation 2001 paper defining nu-parameterized One-Class SVM.

claim_support.claim: Defined Support Vector Data Description (SVDD) enclosing known samples within a minimum-volume hypersphere.
claim_support.evidence: Machine Learning 2004 paper introducing SVDD hypersphere boundaries.

claim_support.claim: Analyzed collapse and geometric failure modes of single-center hypersphere one-class objectives on deep features.
claim_support.evidence: IJCNN 2020 paper analyzing mode/hypersphere collapse in Deep One-Class classification.

claim_support.claim: Introduced L2-normalized hyperspherical triplet embeddings with hard triplet mining.
claim_support.evidence: CVPR 2015 FaceNet paper normalizing deep embeddings to the unit hypersphere under triplet loss.

claim_support.claim: Formulated deep metric learning with triplet networks enforcing relative positive-negative margins.
claim_support.evidence: Hoffer and Ailon triplet metric learning formulation.

claim_support.claim: Provided the PyTorch Metric Learning implementations for cosine TripletMarginLoss and online hard mining.
claim_support.evidence: PyTorch Metric Learning technical report documenting the library modules used in our pipeline.

claim_support.claim: Defined the ResNet-50 convolutional architecture used as our feature extraction backbone.
claim_support.evidence: CVPR 2016 Deep Residual Learning paper.

claim_support.claim: Introduced Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) to enhance local contrast without amplifying uniform background noise.
claim_support.evidence: Graphics Gems IV chapter defining CLAHE.

claim_support.claim: Defined the Adam stochastic optimizer used during training of both baseline and metric-learning models.
claim_support.evidence: Kingma and Ba Adam optimizer paper.

claim_support.claim: Defined Youden's J statistic for selecting an optimal binary operating threshold along an ROC curve.
claim_support.evidence: Cancer 1950 article defining J = TPR - FPR threshold calibration.
